documents.title: High-risk pancreas surveillance cohort links cyst evolution and blood biomarkers in early detection workflows
documents.abstract_text: A high-risk pancreas surveillance cohort combined side-branch IPMN follow-up, cyst evolution tracking, and blood biomarker review to enrich early detection signals. The authors emphasize evidence-backed escalation rules and transparent surveillance intervals.
